errors.unauthorized: Telegram rejected the bot token. Check the token in Settings.
errors.chat_not_found: The chat ID was not found. Check the chat ID in Settings.
errors.bot_blocked: The bot has not been started in this chat, or is blocked. Open the chat with the bot, press Start, then try again.
errors.not_found: The Telegram address was not found. Check the bot token in Settings.
errors.timeout: Telegram did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Cannot reach Telegram. Check this computer's internet connection.
errors.bad_request: Telegram rejected this message. Try regenerating the summary.
errors.bad_response: Telegram's reply could not be read. Try again.
errors.notConfigured: Telegram is not set up yet. Open Settings to add the bot token and chat ID.
errors.unknown: The cause is unknown. Try again.

live.updated: New data arrived through the push API: {{rows}} rows.
live.failed: New data arrived but could not be loaded. Reload the page.

errors.datasetTitle: Sales data could not be loaded
errors.dataset: The local server did not return the sales data. Try again.
errors.noDataset: There is no active data yet. Upload a CSV from Settings.

unmapped.body: The latest data contains values that were never confirmed: {{values}}. {{rows}} rows show as "Unmapped" until the mapping is confirmed.

quality.line: {{read}} rows read, {{clean}} used. {{duplicates}} duplicates removed, {{fixed}} values fixed.

quality.title: Data quality report
quality.description: Every fix applied to the active data before any number was calculated.
quality.arithmetic: Rows whose amounts do not add up
quality.unparseable: Rows dropped because a required value was unreadable
quality.sharedTitle: Names used by more than one outlet

filters.title: Filters
filters.sheetDescription: Every number and chart follows these choices right away.

charts.title: Sales breakdown
charts.description: Tap a bar, slice, cell, bubble or tile to filter every number.
charts.clickToFilter: Tap to filter, tap again to release.

needsTwoMonths.title: Needs two months of data
needsTwoMonths.body: Change is measured from the previous month to the latest one. The data under these filters covers a single month.

map.title: Sales map by region
map.question: Where are sales across Indonesia?
map.footer: Colour = region, matching the region chart. Regions that are not provinces (e.g. Jabodetabek) are drawn on the provinces their branches are in. Tap an area to filter by region.

heatmap.title: Brand by region
heatmap.question: Which brand is strong in which region?
heatmap.footer: Darker means more net sales. Tap a cell to filter by that region and brand together.

brand.title: Brand share
brand.question: What share does each brand have?

daily.title: Daily trend
daily.question: How is the daily trend?
daily.footer: Drag or resize the strip below the chart to zoom into a date range.

outletChange.title: Biggest outlet changes
outletChange.question: Which outlets fell the most?
outletChange.footer: The 10 outlets with the largest rupiah change from the previous month. New outlets are not included. Tap a bar to filter by that outlet.

sku.title: Top SKUs
sku.question: Which SKUs sell most?
sku.footer: Tile colour = brand. Tap a tile to filter by that SKU.

weakest.title: 5 weakest outlets

definition.decline: Outlets whose sales fell most compared with outlets of the same type. Score = the outlet's change minus the median change of its outlet type, so a warung is compared with warungs.
definition.lowest: Outlets with the smallest sales compared with outlets of the same type. Figure = outlet sales divided by the median sales of its outlet type (1.00× = at the median).

weakest.newExcluded_one: A new outlet with no sales last month is not ranked: {{outlets}}.
weakest.newExcluded_other: {{count}} new outlets with no sales last month are not ranked: {{outlets}}.

needsBaseline.title: Months cannot be compared yet
needsBaseline.body: The data under these filters covers a single month, so a decline cannot be measured.

empty.title: No outlets to rank
empty.body: Loosen the filters so some outlets have sales in both months.

summary.title: Summary for Telegram
summary.description: One paragraph for the sales manager. The app computes every number; AI only writes the sentences.
summary.copyFailed: The browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.
summary.error: The summary could not be written. Check that the local server is still running.
summary.stale: The filters have changed. Regenerate so the summary follows the current filters.

sourceNote.llm: AI wrote the sentences; the app filled in and checked every number.
sourceNote.fallback: AI was not used or its answer failed the checks, so the standard template was used with the same numbers.

notice.llm_not_configured: The AI is not set up.
notice.llm_invalid: The AI answer failed the checks twice (for example it wrote a number itself).
notice.llm_failed: The AI could not be reached.
